title: Watermelon Band
wikitext: {{Infobox mousehat |name = Watermelon Band |image = Watermelon Band.png |achievement = Mother Catch |ad = Catch 100 [[Fish|fish]]. |price = {{Price|1000}} }} The '''Watermelon Band''' is a [[Hats|hat]] that can be purchased from the [[Abandoned House]] for {{Price|1000}} after earning the "Mother Catch" [[Achievements|Achievement]] (catch 100 [[Fish|fish]]). It can also be obtained from [[Desert Festival#Emily's Outfit Services|Emily's outfit services]] at the [[Desert Festival]]. Female players have a ≈2% chance to receive the outfit with the Watermelon Band. ==Notes== * The Watermelon Band outfit also includes a [[File:Shirt106.png|24px|link=]] [[Tailoring#Shirts|Shirt]] and [[File:Skirt.png|24px|link=]] [[Tailoring#Pants|Skirt]] (dyed RGB value 83,209,171). ==References== Female players have 48 possible outfits (1/48 ≈ 2.08%). See Content\Data\MakeoverOutfits.xnb.
